blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Cross-view object correspondence identifies the same object across views. However, existing methods often rely on frame-wise matching or sequential tracking, which can propagate correspondence errors under appearance changes or occlusions. Therefore, we introduce cross-view temporal object correspondence, which requires preserving object identity across both views and time from a query mask. To address this, we propose XTrack, a unified framework which repurposes a pretrained video DiT with semantic and spatiotemporal priors for RGB-to-mask latent transport, jointly modeling cross-view matching and temporal tracking. However, naive video DiTs do not guarantee accurate cross-view grounding and often attend to semantically similar yet incorrect objects across views. Thus, we introduce focal cross-view attention alignment, hard negative conditioning, and local context crop strategies to ensure reliable grounding. Finally, beyond these architectural enhancements, we also tackle the lack of dense annotation by introducing a pseudo-label curation pipeline that converts sparse Ego-Exo4D annotations into dense supervision to enable effective video-level training. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of XTrack as a unified framework, ensuring robust temporal consistency and identity preservation.
blocks.zh: 交叉视图对象通信在视图中识别出相同的对象. 然而,现有的方法往往依赖于相框匹配或相继跟踪,这种跟踪可以在外观变化或被占用的情况下传播函证错误. 因此,我们引入了交叉视图时间对象通信,这需要从一个查询口罩中保留整个视图和时间的物体身份. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出XTrack,一个统一框架,它重新使用一个预先训练的视频DiT,其中包含语义学和spatiotemporal前科,用于RGB到面具潜在传输,联合建模交叉视图匹配和时间跟踪. 然而,天真视频DiTs并不能保证准确的交叉取景定位,而且往往会关注各种观点中类似但不正确的物体。 因此,我们引入了焦点交叉视野的注意力协调、硬性负面条件和当地的作物战略,以确保可靠的地基。 最后,除了这些建筑改进外,我们还通过引入一个假标签校正管道来解决缺乏密集注释的问题,该管道将稀疏的"Ego-Exo4D"注释转换为密集的监理,以便能够进行有效的视频级培训. 我们的结果显示了XTrack作为一个统一框架的有效性,确保了强有力的时间一致性和身份保护.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Cross-view object correspondence Fu et al. (2025) , which aims to identify the same object across different viewpoints, is a core problem in many applications, including multi-view scene understanding Grauman et al. (2024) , video perception Kang et al. (2025) , and embodied AI Kim et al. (2019) ; Zhao et al. (2023a) . Prior ego-exo cross-view correspondence methods Fu et al. (2025) ; Kang et al. (2025) ; Mur-Labadia et al. (2025) ; Hu et al. (2025b) have often relied on frame-level matching even with video input. Although some methods incorporate temporal tracking or memory, frame-wise correspondence estimation remains vulnerable to ambiguities that cannot be resolved from individual frames alone.
blocks.zh: 交叉视图对象通信 Fu等人(2025年)旨在从不同角度识别同一物体,是许多应用中的一个核心问题,包括多景场理解Grauman等人(2024年),视频感知. Kang等人(2025年),并体现了AI Kim等人(2019年);赵等人(2023年a). 先前的自我-exo交叉视图对应方法Fu等人(2025年);Kang等人(2025年);Mur-Labadia等人(2025年);Hu等人(2025年b)甚至经常依赖视频输入的帧级匹配. 虽然有些方法包括时间跟踪或内存,但框架对应估计仍然容易出现模糊不清的问题,而单靠单个框架无法解决。

blocks.en:
This limitation is particularly important for real-world video understanding, where object identity must remain consistent across both viewpoints and time.
The same object can appear very differently across viewpoints, and its visibility can change over time due to occlusion, motion blur, or partial observation Koo et al. (2025) ; Rajič et al. (2025) , resulting correspondence can become ambiguous in the subsequent frames. As a result, correspondences from a single frame become ambiguous and unresolvable in such challenging scenarios but recoverable from temporal context or evidence from the other view. Solving correspondence frame-by-frame therefore risks unstable identity assignment and wrong-object matching over time. This raises the key question: how can we model object correspondence jointly across viewpoints and time, rather than treating each frame as an independent matching problem?
blocks.zh:
这一限制对于现实世界的视频理解尤其重要,在视频中,对象身份必须在观点和时间上保持一致。
同一物体在不同观点之间看起来会非常不同,其能见度会随时间而变化,因为被隐匿,运动模糊,或部分观察 Koo等人(2025年); Rajič等人. 2025),由此产生的函文在之后的帧中可能会变得模糊不清. 因此,在这种具有挑战性的情况下,单一框架的函证变得模糊不清和无法解决,但从时间背景或另一种观点的证据中可以收回。 因此,逐一解决函证框架,可能会有不稳定的身份分配和错误对象匹配的风险。 这提出了关键问题:我们如何在观点和时间上共同建模对象对应,而不是把每个框架当作一个独立的匹配问题?

blocks.en: We formalize this as cross-view temporal object correspondence . Concretely, given an ego view video, an exo view video, and a first-frame object mask in one view, the goal is to recover temporally coherent object mask sequences in both views. This is more than a temporal extension of frame-level matching. The model must jointly reason about viewpoint variation and temporal dynamics, while handling large appearance changes, temporary disappearance, and ambiguous observations.
blocks.zh: 我们把这个正式化 作为交叉视时间对象的通信。 具体地说,由于一个自负的视图视频,一个外观视频,和一个视图中的第一帧对象面具,目标是在两种观点中恢复时间上一致的物体面具序列. 这不仅仅是帧级匹配的时间延伸. 该模型必须共同说明观点变化和时间动态,同时处理巨大的外观变化、暂时消失和模棱两可的观察。

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 1 , we compare three paradigms for this setting. A natural adaptation of frame-level methods is a track-then-match pipeline (a), where the first-frame query mask is propagated in query view by a video segmentation model Ravi et al. (2024) , and each frame is independently matched to the target view Mur-Labadia et al. (2025) , without considering temporal consistency in the target view. Another extension is a match-then-track pipeline (b),
which estimates an initial match and then propagates in each view independently. However, if the initial match is wrong, the error propagates through the sequence since each view is tracked independently.
More fundamentally, both (a) and (b) decouple cross-view matching from temporal tracking, limiting ability to jointly leverage evidence across views and time.
blocks.zh:
如图1所示,我们比较了这一设置的三个范式。 帧级方法的自然改造是一款时空对接的管道(a),由视频分区模型Ravi等人(2024年)在查询视图中传播第一帧查询掩码,每个帧独立对应目标视图Mur-Labadia等人. (2025),没有考虑目标观点中的时间一致性. 另外一个扩展是匹配时的轨道管道(b),
它估计初始匹配,然后在每一个视图中独立传播。 然而,如果初始匹配错误,错误通过序列传播,因为每个视图都是独立跟踪的.
更根本的是,(a)和(b)将交叉视图匹配与时间跟踪脱钩,限制了联合利用各种观点和时间的证据的能力。

blocks.en:
Motivated by this limitation, we propose a joint view-time mask prediction formulation, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (c).
Rather than separating matching from tracking or processing each view independently, this formulation unifies within-view temporal tracking and cross-view matching within a single prediction process. This allows the model to use evidence from one view to resolve uncertainty in the other, and to draw on the full temporal context of both videos throughout prediction.
blocks.zh:
基于这一限制,我们提议采用联合视图时间遮罩预测制剂,见图1(c)。
这种配体不是将匹配与每个视图的跟踪或处理分开,而是统一了一个单一的预测过程中的视角内时间跟踪和交叉视图匹配. 这使得模型可以使用一种观点的证据来解决另一种观点的不确定性,并在整个预测过程中利用两个视频的全部时间背景.

blocks.en:
This formulation naturally raises next question: what model can support such joint reasoning across views and time? The model must match the same object across large viewpoint changes and track how objects move and persist over time.
We argue that these priors are inherently encoded in pretrained video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) Wan et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2024b) ; Li et al. (2024) . Through large-scale training, these models develop strong spatiotemporal priors regarding object motion Nam et al. (2025) ; Son et al. (2025) , alongside robust semantic priors that capture how appearances change under varying views, scales, and occlusions Tang et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2023) .
Leveraging these priors allows us to focus supervision on cross-view temporal mask prediction rather than relearning temporal coherence from scratch.
blocks.zh:
这一提法自然提出了下一个问题:哪种模式能够支持这种跨观点和跨时间的联合推理? 该模型必须在大角度的变化中匹配同一对象,并跟踪物体如何移动和长期存在。
我们辩称,这些前科在事先训练过的视频Difusion Transformers (DITs) Wan et al. (2025年); Yang et al. (2024年b) ; Li et al. (2024年) 中固有的编码. 通过大规模培训,这些模型在物体运动Nam等人(2025年)方面发展出强烈的空间前兆;Son等人。 (2025),与强健的语义学前言一起,捕捉不同观点下的外观变化,鳞片,以及占星唐等人(2023);张等人(2023).
利用这些前科使我们能够集中监督跨视时间遮罩预测,而不是从头开始重新学习时间一致性。

blocks.en: Motivated by this, we propose XTrack , which repurposes a pretrained video DiT Wan et al. (2025) under a flow-matching framework Lipman et al. (2022) for joint view-time mask prediction from paired RGB videos. Specifically, we feed the ego and exo videos jointly as a diptych Shin et al. (2025) , that is, a single visual input formed by placing the two views side-by-side, so both views are processed within a shared token space and two mask sequences are inferred within a unified prediction process, keeping both temporal reasoning and cross-view interaction coupled. Since video DiTs do not guarantee accurate cross-view grounding and often attend to semantically similar objects, we further introduce grounding-aware designs that strengthen query-specific grounding. Specifically, we use cross-view attention alignment for query-side grounding, hard negative conditioning to prevent query-agnostic prediction, and local context crops for small objects, preserving their original spatial positions through RoPE Su et al. (2024) alignment.
blocks.zh: 由於此,我們提出XTrack(XTrack),在流配框架Lipman等人(2022年)下重新使用经过预训的视频DiT Wan et al.(2025年),从配对的RGB视频中进行联合观看时间面具预测. 具体地说,我们共同将自我和exo视频作为diptych Shin et al. (2025)提供,即通过将两种观点并存而形成的单一视觉输入,因此两种观点都是在一个共享的符号空间内处理的,两个面具序列都是在一个统一的预测过程中推断的,同时保持时间推理和交叉视图交互的结合. 从录像开始 DiTs不保证准确的交叉视野地面,并经常关注类似物体,我们进一步引入地面意识设计,加强特定查询地面. 具体来说,我们使用交叉视图的注意力对齐来进行查询侧面搁浅,硬负条件来防止查询-不可知的预测,以及小物体的局部上下文作物,通过ROPE Su 等人来保持其原始的空间位置. (2024)对齐.

blocks.en: However, training a video model requires dense and reliable supervision, while Ego-Exo4D Grauman et al. (2024) provides only sparse annotations. To address this gap, we build a pseudo-label curation pipeline that converts sparse masks into reliable dense supervision through bidirectional propagation, cross-view verification, and within-view semantic filtering, enabling effective training of our joint video model.
blocks.zh: 然而,培训一个视频模型需要密集和可靠的监督,而Ego-Exo4D Grauman et al. (2024)只提供很少的说明. 为了弥补这一差距,我们建造了一个假标签校正管道,通过双向传播、交叉视图核查和视内语义过滤,将稀有的口罩转化为可靠的密集监督,从而能够有效地培训我们的联合视频模型。

blocks.en: Experiments demonstrate XTrack as a unified framework achieving competitive performance with robust temporal consistency and identity preservation. Ablations verify the importance of RGB-to-mask flow prediction, query-specific grounding, local context crops, and pretrained video priors.
blocks.zh: 实验显示,XTrack是一个统一的框架,能够以强有力的时间一致性和身份保存来实现竞争性业绩。 缩写验证了RGB到任务流预测,特定查询地面,局部背景作物,以及预训视频前传的重要性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
Cross-view Object Correspondence. Cross-view object correspondence aims to identify the same object across different views, given a query in one view. It is a core task especially in ego-exo perception Grauman et al. (2024) ,
and prior work has explored several directions including view-invariant feature matching Fu et al. (2025) , mask-level correspondence Mur-Labadia et al. (2025) ; Liao et al. (2025) , and foundation model adaptation Pan et al. (2025) ; Hu et al. (2025b) .
Despite these advances, many approaches still rely on frame-level matching or sequential correspondence updates, which can propagate errors under ambiguous observations. We address this limitation by formulating cross-view correspondence as a joint view-time prediction problem that unifies cross-view matching and temporal tracking of object identity from the query mask.
blocks.zh:
交叉视图对象通信. 交叉视图对象通信旨在通过不同观点识别同一对象,在一个视图中给出查询. 这是一项核心任务,特别是在自我-外感方面,Grauman等人(2024年),
和以前的工作探索了几个方向,包括视图-变量特征与Fu等人(2025年)、面具级通信Mur-Labadia等人(2025年)、Liao等人(2025年)和基础模型适应Pan等人(2025年)、Hu等人(2025年b)。
尽管取得了这些进展,许多方法仍然依赖于帧级匹配或相继的函证更新,这可以在模糊的观察下传播错误. 我们通过将交叉视图通信发展成一个联合视图时间预测问题来解决这一限制,这个问题统一了交叉视图匹配和从查询掩码对对象身份的时间跟踪.

blocks.en: Video Object Segmentation. Video object segmentation (VOS) Pont-Tuset et al. (2018) ; Xu et al. (2018) aims to predict coherent object masks over time from an initial prompt or mask. Prior work preserves temporal identity via memory-based propagation Oh et al. (2019) ; Aksan and Hilliges (2019) ; Cheng and Schwing (2022) , decoupled tracking and segmentation Cheng et al. (2023) , query-based mask prediction Cheng et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2021) , and foundation model adaptation Ravi et al. (2024) ; Ding et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2024a) . Despite this progress, they operate on a single video and are not designed to link object identity across views.

blocks.en: Diffusion Models for Perception Tasks. Recent approaches Ke et al. (2024) ; He et al. (2024) ; Nam et al. (2023) ; Tang et al. (2023) ; Hedlin et al. (2023) ; Saxena et al. (2023) show that pretrained diffusion models are effective for both generation and perception, with their features and priors repurposed for segmentation Zhao et al. (2023b) , matching Nam et al. (2023) ; Nam et al. (2025) , and depth estimation Ke et al. (2024) ; He et al. (2024) . This suggests that generative pretraining captures visual structure beyond synthesis. In video, video diffusion models Blattmann et al. (2023a) ; Ma et al. (2024) ; Lin et al. (2024) further learn priors on temporal continuity, object persistence, and appearance variation from large-scale video data. Recent works repurpose these priors for perception tasks such as point tracking Nam et al. (2025) ; Son et al. (2025) , video depth estimation Hu et al. (2025a) ; Shao et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2026) , and point map prediction Jiang et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2025) . However, prior diffusion-based perception methods mostly focus on single-view or within-view settings. In contrast, we use a pretrained video DiT for cross-view temporal correspondence to jointly predict object masks across views and over time.

blocks.en:
This setting is challenging since cross-view correspondence and temporal matching must be solved simultaneously. The model must identify the same object across views while preserving its identity over time under appearance changes, occlusion and reappearance. Therefore, reliable prediction requires joint reasoning across both views and the temporal dimension, rather than solving matching and tracking independently.
To address this, we propose XTrack , which adopts a joint view-time mask prediction formulation using pretrained video DiTs Wan et al. (2025) , rather than separating cross-view matching from temporal tracking Pan et al. (2025) .
As shown in Fig. 2 , XTrack takes V ego V^{\text{ego}} and V exo V^{\text{exo}} along with M 0 q M_{0}^{\text{q}} provided in one view q ∈ { ego , exo } \text{q}\in\{\text{ego},\text{exo}\} and jointly predicts corresponding mask sequences in both views, leveraging the spatiotemporal priors of video DiTs Nam et al. (2025) ; Son et al. (2025) .
However, vanilla video DiTs do not guarantee query-specific grounding and may attend to semantically similar objects Tang et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2023) . We thus introduce cross-view object grounding, including focal attention alignment, hard negative conditioning, and local context crops for small objects.
To bridge the gap between the strong temporal prior of video DiTs and their lack of cross-view matching priors, we train XTrack in two stages.

blocks.en: 4.2 Cross-view RGB-to-Mask Flow via Video DiT Repurposing

blocks.en:
Standard video DiTs Wan et al. (2025) are trained to generate temporally coherent videos, implicitly learning to preserve object identity under motion, occlusion, and viewpoint changes. Recent works Nam et al. (2025) ; Son et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2023) ; Tang et al. (2023) show that these priors can be repurposed for tracking tasks, without requiring explicit tracking supervision. These priors provide a strong inductive bias for maintaining object identity, which is essential for consistent mask prediction across views and time.
Our goal, however, is not to synthesize a new RGB video, but to infer object mask sequences grounded in paired ego-exo RGB observations.

blocks.en: 4.3 Unified Ego-Exo Token Space
blocks.zh: 4.3 统一电子交换空间

blocks.en:
Cross-view temporal correspondence requires the model to resolve ambiguity in one view using evidence from the other.
If ego and exo videos are processed independently, such cross-view evidence is either unavailable or only introduced through an additional matching stage, making prediction vulnerable when the queried object is occluded or ambiguous in one view.
We therefore process the two views within a unified token space. Specifically, we arrange ego and exo frames as a diptych Shin et al. (2025) , where the two views are spatially concatenated into a single composite frame. The query mask is provided as conditioning on the query side, while the opposite side receives an empty mask. The video DiT then processes ego-view tokens, exo-view tokens and conditioning tokens jointly within a single spatiotemporal sequence, following Eq. 3 . The query and key matrices decompose as: Q l = Concat ​ ( Q l ego , Q l exo , Q l cond ) , K l = Concat ​ ( K l ego , K l exo , K l cond ) , Q_{l}=\text{Concat}(Q_{l}^{\text{ego}},Q_{l}^{\text{exo}},Q_{l}^{\text{cond}}),\,K_{l}=\text{Concat}(K_{l}^{\text{ego}},K_{l}^{\text{exo}},K_{l}^{\text{cond}}), (5) where Q l ego , Q l exo , Q l cond Q_{l}^{\text{ego}},Q_{l}^{\text{exo}},Q_{l}^{\text{cond}} and K l ego , K l exo , K l cond K_{l}^{\text{ego}},K_{l}^{\text{exo}},K_{l}^{\text{cond}} denote the query and key projections of ego, exo, and conditioning tokens at layer l l . This grouping induces a block structure in the attention matrix, as shown in Fig. 7 .
We refer to ego-to-ego and exo-to-exo attention as within-view attention, which captures spatial and temporal interactions within each video. In contrast, A l ego → exo A_{l}^{\text{ego}\rightarrow\text{exo}} and A l exo → ego A_{l}^{\text{exo}\rightarrow\text{ego}} denote cross-view attention, where ego queries attend to exo keys and vice versa, to establish object correspondence across views.
Since full attention is applied globally over both views, tokens in one view can access cross-view evidence at every layer, enabling to resolve ambiguity using cross-view evidence during prediction, rather than relying on a fixed initial match. As a result, cross-view matching and within-view temporal propagation are modeled jointly within a single process.

To provide stronger object-level evidence, we introduce an object-centered local context crop. This keeps the local tokens aligned with the global token layout, allowing them to provide high-resolution object evidence while still referring to the correct scene region. The local crop is treated as an additional conditioning input, alongside the query mask.

blocks.en: Figure 3: 2D pretraining with cycle consistency.

blocks.en: Training the full video model requires learning cross-view correspondence and temporal consistency simultaneously. It is challenging since weak correspondence early in training can be carried through the temporal dimension, leading to identity drift or wrong-object propagation. We therefore adopt stage-wise training to stabilize learning. Unlike match-then-track pipelines that first fix a correspondence and then propagate it independently, our model keeps correspondence and propagation coupled within a single video DiT.

We then fine-tune on video sequences to extend the image-level matching prior to temporal prediction, utilizing dense pseudo-labels generated by our curation pipeline, as detailed in Sec. 5 . This encourages the model to learn to maintain object identity under motion, occlusion, and reappearance while preserving cross-view grounding. At inference, the model does not separate matching and tracking. Instead, it jointly predicts both views over time, allowing cross-view correspondence and temporal propagation to be updated together within the unified token space.

blocks.en: 5 Pseudo-Label Curation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 5 Pseudo-Label 管道

blocks.en: Figure 4: Pseudo-label curation pipeline. (a) performs bidirectional propagation from anchor frames and identifies unreliable regions, which are refined by (b) cross-view geometric verification and further filtered by (c) within-view semantic verification.
blocks.zh: 图4:Pseudo-label 校准管道。 (a) 从锚架上进行双向传播,并查明不可靠的区域,通过(b) 截面几何核查加以改进,并通过(c) 截面内语义核查加以进一步过滤。

blocks.en:
Motivation. Ego-Exo4D Grauman et al. (2024) provides videos at 30 FPS but mask annotations only at 1 FPS, making temporally dense supervision unavailable. A straightforward solution is to propagate sparse annotations using a propagation model Ravi et al. (2024) .
However, we find that SAM2 alone is unreliable in ego–exo cross-view videos, especially in the ego view where occlusions and large viewpoint changes often cause tracking failures. The key challenge is therefore to identify which propagated masks are reliable enough for supervision. To address this, we propose an automatic curation pipeline that leverages cross-view information from the exo view to detect and refine unreliable ego-view pseudo labels, combining geometric and semantic cues from foundation models Siméoni et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh:
动静. Ego-Exo4D Grauman等人(2024年)提供30 FPS的视频,但只提供1 FPS的口罩说明,使得时间密集的监管无法使用. 一个直接的解决办法是使用Ravi等人(2024年)的传播模型传播稀疏的说明。
然而,我们发现光是SAM2在自我——exo交叉视图视频中是不可靠的,特别是自我观点中,隔离和大视角的变化往往导致跟踪失败。 因此,关键的挑战是如何确定哪些宣传口罩是可靠的,足以进行监督。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议建立一个自动校准管道,利用外景的交叉视图信息来检测和完善不可靠的自我视角假标签,将基建模型Siméoni等人(2025年)的几何和语义提示结合起来;Wang等人(2025年).

blocks.en: Bidirectional Mask Propagation and Refinement Region Selection. To obtain an internal estimate of reliability, we perform bidirectional propagation from two annotated anchor frames, one forward and one backward, as shown in Fig. 4 (a). If propagation is stable, both paths should produce consistent masks in the intermediate region. In practice, however, they often diverge due to occlusion, rapid viewpoint changes, and hand-object interactions. We use this forward-backward inconsistency as a reliability signal. Specifically, we compute the mIoU between the forward and backward masks within each chunk, and treat low-agreement chunks as refinement targets.
blocks.zh: 双向面具传播与完善区域选择. 为了获得对可靠性的内部估计,我们通过两个附加说明的锚架进行双向传播,一个向前,一个向后,见图4(a)。 如果传播稳定,两种途径都应在中间区域产生一致的口罩。 然而,在实践中,它们往往因隔离、观点的迅速变化和手物相互作用而有所不同。 我们用这种前向不一致作为可靠性信号. 具体地说,我们计算每个块内前部和后部口罩之间的mIoU,并将低协议块作为完善目标.

blocks.en: Cross-view Geometric Verification. Ego-view propagation often fails when the object reappears after occlusion, producing inconsistent forward and backward candidates. To resolve this ambiguity, we use exo view propagated masks as pseudo ground truth, since exo videos in Ego-Exo4D Grauman et al. (2024) are captured by static cameras, providing more stable masks than ego views. Since the exo reference is captured at the same time, it provides more direct evidence than temporally-distant ego anchors. A natural alternative is explicit geometric triangulation, but it is unreliable due to fisheye distortion in ego cameras. Instead, we use geometry-aware VGGT features Wang et al. (2025) learned from large-scale pretraining, which provide robust cross-view correspondence without requiring undistorted imagery. For each unreliable frame, we extract VGGT features from the forward/backward ego-mask candidates and the exo reference, and compute similarity maps between each ego candidate and the exo reference. As shown in Fig. 4 (b), we select the candidate whose similarity exceeds a predefined threshold.
blocks.zh: 跨视几何验证. 当物体在被隔离后重新出现时,Ego-view传播往往会失败,产生前后不一致的前向和后向候选人. 为了解决这一模糊性,我们使用外视传播的口罩作为伪地面真相,因为Ego-Exo4D Grauman等人(2024年)的外视视频被静态摄像头拍摄,提供比自负视角更稳定的口罩. 由于外引物同时被捕获,它提供了比时间遥远的自我锚更直接的证据. 一个自然的替代品是明显的几何三角形,但由于自负相机中的鱼眼扭曲,它不可靠. 相反,我们使用几何意识的VGGT特征Wang等人. (2025年)从大规模预训中吸取了教训,这些预训提供了强健的交叉视图通信,而不需要不清晰的图像. 对于每一个不可靠的框架,我们从向前/后向的自我面具候选人和exo参考物中提取VGGT特征,并计算每个自我候选人和exo参考物之间的相似性图. 如图4(b)所示,我们选择的候选者,其相似性超过预先确定的门槛值。

blocks.en:
Within-view Semantic Verification. Cross-view geometric verification resolves ambiguity using cross-view evidence. To further ensure identity consistency, we complement it with a within-view semantic verification stage.
We verify whether the selected candidate remains consistent with a nearby within-view anchor. Since geometric matching is unreliable within a single view, we instead use DINOv3 Siméoni et al. (2025) features to measure semantic similarity. Specifically, we extract DINOv3 features from the candidate, as in the geometric verification, and the neighboring within-view anchor ground-truth, and retain the candidate only if the similarity exceeds a predefined threshold, as shown in Fig. 4 (c).
blocks.zh:
内视语义验证. 交叉视图几何校验利用交叉视图证据解决模糊问题. 为了进一步确保身份的一致性,我们用一个内视语义核查阶段来补充它。
我们核实被选中的候选人是否与附近的内视主播保持一致。 由于几何匹配在单一视图中是不可靠的,我们转而使用DINOv3 Siméoni等人. (2025) 特征用于测量语义相似性. 具体地说,我们从候选人中提取DINOv3的特征,如几何校验,以及相邻的视野内锚地-真实性,只有在相似性超过预先确定的阈值时才保留候选人,如图4(c)所示。

blocks.en: After these steps, each unreliable chunk is either corrected by cross-view verification or removed by semantic filtering. The final dense supervision retains only masks satisfying both geometric and semantic criteria, producing cleaner and more temporally consistent tracks. Details are in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 在这些步骤之后,每个不可靠的块要么通过交叉视图校正,要么通过语义过滤去除. 最终密集的监管只保留符合几何和语义标准的口罩,产生更清洁和时间上更一致的轨道. 详情见附录C。

Each sample is defined for a specific (ego view, exo view, object) tuple, resulting in a challenging benchmark that emphasizes both cross-view correspondence and long-term tracking stability. In Match-then-Track , the matching model predicts the single-frame target mask, after which SAM2 propagates both views independently.

blocks.en: 6.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 6.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Tab. 1 compares XTrack against prior cross-view correspondence models evaluated under Track-then-Match (T → \rightarrow M) and Match-then-Track (M → \rightarrow T) pipelines.
These baselines are fundamentally constrained by their decoupled matching and tracking mechanisms.
Specifically, the T → \rightarrow M pipeline relies heavily on frame-level matching. Since target-side masks are predicted independently without temporal context, it suffers from severe temporal inconsistency, yielding notably low VA and mR@IoU scores.
Conversely, M → \rightarrow T uses a strong SAM2 ( Ravi et al., 2024 ) -assisted tracking baseline that ensures robust within-view propagation.
We find that establishing an initial match and subsequently tracking it with a powerful model like SAM2 generally provides greater overall stability than the T → \rightarrow M approach. While SAM2 benefits from large-scale annotation, which guarantees high mask quality given a reliable prompt and naturally translates to strong performance on mask-quality-related metrics, our unified XTrack framework still achieves highly competitive performance, particularly in VA and mR@IoU, by jointly reasoning across views and time within a unified token space.
We do, however, observe a trade-off regarding per-frame spatial precision ( 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} ).
We attribute this to the highly compressed latent space of the video DiT, where fine-grained boundaries for small objects can be diluted during decoding.
As a result, the model accurately localizes the object’s presence (maintaining high VA) but occasionally struggles to delineate its precise contours (visualization in Appendix Fig. 11 ).
Nevertheless, XTrack offers a key architectural advantage in replacing complex pipelines that stitch multiple foundation models with a unified framework with superior tracking capabilities, as evidenced by our high VA and mR@IoU .
Fig. 5 illustrates our qualitative results.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduce cross-view temporal object correspondence that requires preserving object identity jointly across views and over time from a single query mask. Unlike prior methods that rely on decoupled frame-level matching, we propose joint view-time mask prediction, a unified formulation that couples cross-view matching and temporal tracking within a video DiT. We instantiate this through XTrack, which repurposes a video DiT to perform RGB-to-mask latent transport over paired ego-exo videos. By leveraging the spatiotemporal priors of the video DiT alongside targeted cross-view object grounding mechanisms, our framework ensures query-conditioned mask predictions. We further develop a pseudo-label curation pipeline that converts sparse annotations into reliable dense supervision for effective training of XTrack. Experiments show that XTrack produces temporally consistent and identity-preserving mask sequences across views, with comparable mask quality.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了跨视时间对象通信,需要从单个的查询掩码中联合保存跨视点的物体身份. 与之前依赖于脱钩帧级匹配的方法不同,我们提出联合视图时罩预测,一种情侣交叉视图匹配和视频DiT内时间跟踪的统一配方. 我们通过 XTrack 进行即时处理, 它可以重新使用一个视频 DiT 来进行 RGB-to-mask 潜在传输, 通过配对的自我-exo 视频。 通过利用视频DiT的瞬间前传与目标交叉视图对象的地面机制,我们的框架确保了有查询条件的面具预测。 我们进一步发展了一个假标签的校准管道,将稀疏的注解转化为可靠的密集监督,以有效培训XTrack. 实验显示,XTrack在时间上产生在跨视线上一致和保持身份的面具序列,具有相当的面具质量.

blocks.en: Appendix A Challenges of Cross-view Object Correspondence
blocks.zh: 附录A 交叉视图对象通信的挑战

blocks.en: Motivation. We revisit the task of cross-view object correspondence Fu et al. (2025) and extend it to cross-view temporal object correspondence . Prior to presenting our approach, we first discuss why this task is inherently challenging and motivate the need for temporal reasoning. Fig. 6 illustrates these challenges in detail, complementing the paradigm comparison and examples in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 动静. 我们重新审视交叉视图对象函授的任务 Fu et al.(2025),并将其扩展到交叉视图时间对象函授. 在提出我们的方法之前,我们首先讨论为什么这项任务本质上具有挑战性,并促使需要时间推理。 图6详细介绍了这些挑战,补充了图1中的范式比较和实例。

blocks.en:
Failure cases of the track-then-match paradigm. While tracking ensures temporal consistency on the query side, target predictions are produced independently per frame, with no explicit constraint enforcing temporal coherence across them. This leads to temporally inconsistent predictions on the target side.
Therefore, we identify two primary failure modes on the query side in frame-level cross-view object correspondence. As shown in the second and third columns of Fig. 6 , when the query object is absent in a given query frame yet present in the target view, frame-level inference lacks a meaningful query signal, causing the model to either produce an empty prediction or hallucinate a correspondence to an incorrect object. The 4th to 6th columns further illustrate cases where the query object is visible but its appearance is highly ambiguous due to partial occlusion or an uninformative viewpoint, making target localization unreliable compared to cases where the object is fully observable. These failure modes compound to produce incomplete and inconsistent target predictions, ultimately resulting in temporally incoherent correspondences, as shown in the second row of Fig. 6 .
blocks.zh:
赛道的失败案例 虽然跟踪可确保查询方面的时间一致性,但目标预测是每个框架独立得出的,没有明显的制约,可以加强它们之间的时间一致性。 这导致目标一侧的预测在时间上不一致.
因此,我们在帧级交叉视图对象通信中,在查询侧面识别出两种主故障模式. 如图6的第二列和第三列所示,当特定查询框架中没有查询对象,而目标视图中却存在时,帧级推论缺乏有意义的查询信号,导致模型要么产生空预测,要么对不正确的对象产生幻觉. 第四至第六栏进一步说明了查询对象可见但因部分隐蔽或非信息化观点而外观高度模糊的情况,使得目标本地化与该对象完全可观察到的情况相比不可靠. 这些失败模式复合生成不完整和不一致的目标预测,最终导致时间不一致的函证,如图6第二行所示.

blocks.en: From frame-level to temporal correspondence. To address these limitations, we reformulate the problem as cross-view temporal object correspondence. By incorporating temporal context beyond individual frames, our method alleviates the ambiguities inherent in frame-level inference and yields temporally consistent object correspondences across views.
blocks.zh: 从帧层到时间层的通信. 为了解决这些局限性,我们把问题重新表述为交叉视时间对象通信. 通过将时间背景纳入单个框架之外,我们的方法减轻了框架层面推论中固有的含混不清之处,并产生时间上一致的、不同观点的物体对应。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Motivation for temporal reasoning in cross-view object correspondence. Conventional frame-wise matching methods suffer from several failure modes, including empty predictions when the query object is absent and incorrect correspondences under ambiguous appearances. Since predictions are made independently for each frame, the resulting target correspondences often become temporally inconsistent.
blocks.zh: 图6:交叉视图对象函证中时间推理动机. 常规帧匹配方法有几种故障模式,包括查询对象缺失时的空预测,以及模棱两可的外观不正确的函证. 由于每个帧的预测都是独立的,因此由此产生的目标对应往往在时间上变得不一致.

blocks.zh: 附录B XTrack 细节

blocks.en: B.1 Architectural Details
blocks.zh: B.1 建筑细节

blocks.en: Our goal is to jointly model cross-view object correspondence and temporal propagation within a single framework. To this end, we build XTrack on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B Wan et al. (2025) , a large-scale pretrained video Diffusion Transformer (DiT). This backbone is chosen since it encodes rich priors on object motion, persistence, and appearance variations across viewpoints, which are essential for cross-view correspondence. The model consists of a 3D causal VAE, a text encoder Raffel et al. (2020) , and a DiT. The VAE compresses input videos into latent tokens with spatial and temporal downsampling, and we keep both the VAE and text encoder frozen to preserve their pretrained representations, updating only the DiT.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是在一个单一的框架内联合建立跨视物体对应和时间传播模型。 为此,我们在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上建造XTrack. Wan et al. (2025),一个大规模预训视频Difusion Transformer(DIT). 选择这个主干线是因为它编码了丰富的关于物体运动、持久性和不同观点的外观差异的前奏,这对于交叉视图的对应至关重要。 该模型由3D因子VAE,文本编码器Raffel等人(2020年)和DiT组成. VAE将输入视频压缩成具有空间和时间下采样的潜伏符号,我们同时将VAE和文本编码器冷冻起来,以保存其预先训练过的表示,仅更新DiT.

blocks.en: To adapt the pretrained model without destroying its learned priors, we employ LoRA adapters Hu et al. (2022) instead of full-finetuning. Specifically, we attach LoRA modules to all attention projections and feed-forward layers. This allows task-specific adaptation while keeping the original weights intact, which is critical for retaining the pretrained DiT’s generative, spatiotemporal, and semantic priors.
blocks.zh: 为了在不破坏前科的前提下改造预训模式,我们使用LORA适配器 胡 et等人(2022年),不全程调整. 具体地说,我们将LORA模块附加到所有注意力预测和向导层中. 这样可以针对特定任务进行调整,同时保持原有的重量不变,这对于保留预先训练的DiT的基因、瞬间和语义学前科至关重要。

blocks.en: B.2.1 Focal Attention Alignment
blocks.zh: B.2.1 重点注意的一致

blocks.en: B.2.2 Hard Negative Conditioning
blocks.zh: B.2.2 硬负条件

blocks.en: To handle instance ambiguity, we introduce a negative conditioning signal. For a training chunk with another valid object instance in the same take, we encode that object’s first-frame mask with the VAE and place it on the source side of the diptych as a negative condition. The model is then evaluated under both the positive query condition and the negative condition. The hard-negative loss penalizes the model when the prediction under the negative condition becomes too similar to the prediction under the positive condition.
blocks.zh: 为了处理实例的模糊性,我们引入了一个负条件信号. 对于一个具有相同情况下另一个有效物体实例的训练块,我们用 VAE 编码对象的第一帧面具,并将它放在diptych 的源侧作为负条件。 然后在正查询条件和负条件下评价该模型. 当负态下的预测与正态下的预测过于相似时,硬负态损失会惩罚模型.

blocks.en: This design explicitly exposes the model to competing same-scene objects. Same-category siblings can be filtered when their supervision is ambiguous, and if no valid sibling exists, the negative condition is sampled from a buffer. This makes the negative path a structural conditioning branch rather than only a loss-level modification.
blocks.zh: 这种设计明确将模型暴露于竞争的同景物. 当同一类兄弟姐妹的监管模棱两可时,可以对其进行过滤,如果不存在有效的兄弟姐妹,则从缓冲物中提取负面条件样本. 这使得负路径成为一个结构调节分支,而不仅仅是损失级的修改.

blocks.en: B.2.3 Local Context Crop
blocks.zh: B.2.3 本地背景作物

blocks.en: The full diptych latent is spatially compressed by the VAE, so small objects may be represented by only a few tokens. To provide higher-resolution evidence, we construct an object-centered crop from the source view. Specifically, we compute the union bounding box of the query mask, dilate it by a margin ratio, resize the crop to a fixed resolution, and encode it with the same VAE used for the global input. The resulting crop latents are appended to the conditioning tokens rather than replacing the global diptych tokens. This allows the model to access both global scene context and local object details.
blocks.zh: 完全的凹陷潜伏由VAE在空间上压缩,所以小物体可能只有几个符号表示. 为了提供更高分辨率的证据,我们从源角度构建了以物体为中心的作物。 具体来说,我们计算了查询掩码的结合边框,用比值放大,将裁剪大小调整为固定分辨率,并用用于全局输入的相同的VAE编码. 由此产生的作物潜伏物附着在调节符上,而不是取代全球的凹陷符。 这使得模型既可以访问全局场景背景,也可以访问局部对象细节.

blocks.en: To preserve spatial consistency, the crop tokens are not treated as an independent image. We assign RoPE coordinates according to the crop location in the original full frame. Thus, a crop token retains its corresponding frame, height, and width position relative to the global diptych canvas. During training, the local context crop is used only for small-object chunks and is randomly dropped with a fixed probability, preventing the model from relying exclusively on local context crops.
blocks.zh: 为了保持空间一致性,作物符号不被视为一个独立的图像。 我们根据原始全帧的作物位置 分配RoPE坐标 因此,一个作物标志相对于全球的凹陷布保留了相应的框架,高度和宽度位置. 在训练期间,局部上下文作物只用于小对象块,随机投放时有固定的概率,防止模型完全依赖局部上下文作物.

blocks.en: B.3 Additional Training Strategy
blocks.zh: B.3 补充培训战略

blocks.en: B.3.1 Conditioning Mask Augmentation.
blocks.zh: B.3.1 条件面具增强。

blocks.en: We also augment the input query mask before VAE encoding. At each training step, the conditioning mask is sampled from three prompt types. The original mask is used as the strongest prompt, a downsampled and re-upsampled coarse mask simulates noisy annotation, and the bounding box mask provides weaker spatial supervision. All variants are encoded by the same VAE and inserted into the same query-side conditioning region of the diptych. This keeps the input interface unchanged while exposing the model to different prompt qualities.
blocks.zh: 我们还在VAE编码前增加了输入查询掩码. 在每个训练步骤上,调制口罩都从三种急速类型中抽取. 最初的口罩用作最强的即时器,下取样和重取样的粗口罩模拟吵闹的注解,边框口罩提供较弱的空间监督. 所有变体都由相同的VAE编码,并插入到diptych的同一个查询边条件区. 这使得输入界面保持不变,同时将模型暴露于不同的即时品质.

blocks.en: B.4 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: B.4 执行细节

The diptych latent has spatial resolution h × ( w q + w q ¯ ) h\times(w^{\text{q}}+w^{\bar{\text{q}}}) and temporal length T z T_{z} , determined by VAE compression. Each training sample contains T = 29 T=29 frames, which are encoded into T z = 8 T_{z}=8 latent frames, with ego scene at 448 × 448 448\times 448 and exo scene at 448 × 800 448\times 800 .

blocks.en: Appendix C Pseudo-Label Curation Pipeline Details
blocks.zh: 附录C Pseudo-Label 管道细节

blocks.en: C.1 Bidirectional Propagation Details
blocks.zh: C.1 双向传播详情

blocks.en:
Extending sparse annotations to dense mask tracks via a propagation model is a standard practice in video segmentation benchmarks such as VISOR, UVO, MUVOD, and HD-EPIC Darkhalil et al. (2022) ; Wang et al. (2021) ; Wei et al. (2025) ; Perrett et al. (2025) . Following this established protocol, we adopt SAM2-hiera-large Ravi et al. (2024) , a state-of-the-art propagation model, as the backbone of our pseudo-label generation pipeline.
Given two consecutive annotated anchor frames, we perform bidirectional propagation: forward propagation from the earlier anchor and backward propagation from the later anchor. For each temporal chunk bounded by anchor frames, we initialize SAM2 with the ground-truth mask and propagate masks across all intermediate frames, producing forward and backward candidate mask sequences.
However, propagation errors frequently occur in ego-view videos due to occlusion, hand-object interaction, and rapid viewpoint changes. This motivates the need for a subsequent reliability estimation and refinement process.
blocks.zh:
通过传播模式将稀疏的说明扩展至密集的口罩轨迹,是VISOR、UVO、MUVOD和HD-EPIC Darkhalil等人(2022年)、Wang等人(2021年)、Wei等人(2025年)、Perret等人(2025年)等视频分区基准的标准做法。 根据这项既定协议,我们采用了SAM2-hiera大型Ravi et al.(2024年)这一最先进的传播模式,作为我们制造假标签管道的支柱。
由于连续两个附加说明的锚架,我们进行双向传播:从早先的锚架进行前向传播,从后来的锚架进行后向传播。 对于以锚框为界的每一个时间块,我们用地面真面罩初始化SAM2,并在所有中间框上传播口罩,产生前向和后向候选口罩序列.
然而,由于隔离、手物互动和快速的视角变化,自我视觉视频中经常出现传播错误。 这就促使有必要随后进行可靠性估计和完善。

blocks.en: C.2 Unreliable Chunk Selection Details
blocks.zh: C.2 不可靠的春克选择细节

blocks.en:
To identify unreliable regions, we exploit the disagreement between forward and backward propagations. Intuitively, if propagation is stable, both directions should produce consistent masks for the same frame.
A straightforward way to estimate reliability is to reconstruct a mask by composing forward and backward propagations and compare it against the anchor ground truth, as done in prior work Darkhalil et al. (2022) . However, this approach evaluates consistency only at the anchor endpoints, and therefore does not directly reflect the reliability of individual intermediate frames. In particular, errors such as drift that are corrected near the anchor remain undetected under this formulation.
Instead, we directly compare the forward and backward masks at each frame. For each frame within a chunk, we compute the mIoU between the forward-propagated mask and the backward-propagated mask. We then aggregate this frame-wise consistency into a chunk-level reliability score by averaging the mIoU values across the chunk.
Chunks whose average mIoU falls below a predefined threshold are marked as unreliable and selected for further refinement. In addition, to better localize failure regions, we identify consecutive frames with low mIoU and treat them as unreliable temporal segments within the chunk.
This bidirectional consistency check serves as a lightweight yet effective proxy for propagation reliability. Unlike endpoint-based reconstruction metrics, our approach directly measures disagreement at each frame and is therefore more sensitive to local failures.
blocks.zh:
为了确定不可靠的区域,我们利用前向和后向传播之间的分歧。 直觉上,如果传播是稳定的,两个方向都应该为同一帧产生一致的口罩.
估计可靠性的一个直截了当的方法是通过编织前向和后向传播来重建一个面具,并将它与锚地的真相进行比较,正如先前的《Darkhalil等人》(2022年)中所做的那样。 然而,这种方法只在锚点评价一致性,因此并不直接反映单个中间帧的可靠性. 特别是,根据这种提法,在锚附近纠正的漂移等错误仍未被发现。
相反,我们直接比较每一帧的前后面罩。 对于一个块内的每一帧,我们计算前传口罩和后传口罩之间的mIoU. 然后,我们通过整个块的mIoU值的平均值,将这种帧一致性汇总成一个块级的可靠性分数。
其平均mIoU低于预定阈值的块被标记为不可靠并被选作进一步完善. 此外,为了更好地将故障区域本地化,我们确定连续帧的mIoU,并将它们视为块内不可靠的时间段。
这种双向一致性检查是传播可靠性的一种轻量级但有效的代用品。 与基于终点的重建指标不同,我们的方法直接衡量每个框架的分歧,因此对当地失败更为敏感。

blocks.en: C.3 Cross-view Geometric Verification Details
blocks.zh: C.3 交叉视图几何验证细节

blocks.en:
For chunks identified as unreliable, we resolve the ambiguity between forward and backward propagation candidates using cross-view geometric verification.
At each timestamp, we obtain a reference mask from the exo view by independently applying SAM2 propagation. Since exo cameras are static and exhibit significantly less motion blur and occlusion compared to ego views, their propagated masks are empirically more stable and serve as a reliable cross-view reference.
Instead of explicit geometric triangulation, which is not well-suited for large viewpoint disparities and dynamic scenes, we leverage VGGT Wang et al. (2025) features to establish correspondence across views. Specifically, we extract dense feature maps from a pretrained VGGT encoder for both forward and backward ego-view candidates and the exo-view reference.
For each candidate, we compute cosine similarity between the feature vectors within the masked regions. Concretely, we first perform mask-aware average pooling over the feature maps to obtain a representative feature vector for each region, and then compute cosine similarity between the ego-view candidate and the exo-view reference. In addition, we compute a dense similarity map and evaluate its spatial consistency to ensure that the correspondence is not driven by spurious local matches.
The final matching score is obtained by combining the region-level similarity and the spatial consistency of the similarity map. We then select the forward or backward candidate with the higher matching score as the refined mask for that frame.
This verification step is applied only when the object is visible in the exo view. When the object is fully occluded or absent in the exo view, this step is skipped, and the pipeline falls back to within-view semantic verification.
blocks.zh:
对于被确定为不可靠的块,我们利用交叉视野几何核查来解决前向传播和后向传播候选人之间的模糊性。
在每个时间戳上,我们通过独立应用SAM2传播从exo视图中获取一个参考面罩. 由于exo相机是静态的,与自我观点相比,显示的动作模糊度和隐蔽性明显较低,因此其传播的口罩在经验上更加稳定,并成为可靠的交叉视图参考.
我们利用VGGT Wang et al,而不是显式的几何三角形,这种三角形不适合大视差和动态场景。 (2025)建立跨观点的通信功能. 具体地说,我们从一个经过预先训练的VGGT编码器中提取了密集的特征图,供前向和后向的自我视图候选人和exo-view参考.
对于每个候选者,我们计算蒙蔽区域内特征矢量之间的同位素相似性. 具体地说,我们首先在特征图上进行遮罩-意识平均集合,以获得每个区域的代表性特征矢量,然后计算自我-视图候选人与exo-view参考物之间的同位素相似性. 此外,我们计算出密集的相似度图,并评估其空间一致性,以确保函文不会被虚假的本地匹配驱动.
最终的匹配分数是通过将地区级相似度和相似度图的空间一致性相结合而获得的. 然后,我们选择具有较高比分的前向或后向候选者作为该帧的精细面具.
此校验步骤只有在对象在外视图中可见时才适用. 当对象在exo视图中被完全占用或缺席时,这一步骤被跳过,管道又回到视图内语义验证.

blocks.en: C.4 Within-view Semantic Verification Details
blocks.zh: C.4 内视语义核查细节

blocks.en:
The cross-view verification stage provides a relative selection between candidates but does not guarantee absolute correctness. Moreover, it cannot be applied when exo-view references are unavailable. To address these limitations, we introduce a within-view identity verification stage based on semantic consistency.
For each selected candidate mask, we compare it against the nearest ego-view anchor ground-truth mask. In practice, we consider both preceding and succeeding anchors and select the one that yields higher semantic similarity.
We extract DINOv3 Siméoni et al. (2025) features from both the candidate region and the anchor ground-truth region. Similar to the geometric verification stage, we apply mask-aware average pooling to obtain region-level feature vectors, and compute cosine similarity between them.
If the similarity exceeds a predefined threshold, the candidate is accepted as valid pseudo ground truth. Otherwise, it is discarded. This step effectively filters out cases where the selected mask corresponds to a different object instance or exhibits severe semantic drift.
When cross-view verification is skipped, due to exo-view occlusion, we directly apply within-view verification to both forward and backward candidates. Among the candidates that satisfy the similarity threshold, we select the one with higher similarity. If neither candidate passes the threshold, the entire segment is discarded.
blocks.zh:
交叉视图核查阶段在候选人之间进行相对选择,但不能保证绝对正确。 此外,如果无法提供外观参考文献,则不能适用。 为解决这些局限性,我们引入了基于语义一致性的内视身份验证阶段.
对于每个被选中的口罩, 我们比较它与最近的自我-视野主播地面-真相口罩。 在实践中,我们既考虑前锚又考虑后锚,并选择产生更高语义相似性的锚.
我们从候选地区和锚点地面真相地区提取DINov3 Siméoni等人(2025年)的特点。 与几何校验阶段类似,我们采用遮罩-感知平均集合来获得区域级特征向量,并计算它们之间的同位素相似性.
如果相似性超过预先设定的阈值,候选人被接受为有效的伪地真言. 否则,它将被抛弃。 该步骤有效地过滤出所选掩码对应不同对象实例或显示严重语义漂移的情况。
当交叉视图核查因外视闭塞而被跳过时,我们直接对前视和后视两个候选人进行横向核查。 在符合相似性阈值的候选人中,我们选择了具有较高相似性的候选人。 如果两个候选人都没有超过门槛值,则整个部分将被丢弃。

blocks.en: C.5 Dataset Examples and Statistics
blocks.zh: C.5 数据集实例和统计

blocks.en: Applying the proposed pseudo-label curation pipeline results in a large-scale pseudo-dense dataset comprising 708 training videos and 191 validation videos, with a total of 14M and 172K annotated frames, respectively. Here, a video corresponds to a unique take, and each track is defined as a unique (take, object) pair. As a result, a single video may contain multiple tracks when multiple objects are annotated. The total number of tracks is 3K in the training set and 300 in the validation set, and the frame count is computed by aggregating all frames across tracks. Compared to the original sparse annotations, our pipeline significantly increases temporal coverage, enabling frame-level supervision across diverse scenarios. As shown in Fig. 14 , the dataset covers a wide range of activities, including cooking, sports, and daily behaviors. Objects typically occupy a small portion of the frame, making segmentation and cross-view correspondence more challenging under large viewpoint changes and occlusions. When constructing the validation split, we carefully sample videos to preserve distributions of task categories (Fig. 14 (c)) and object scale (Fig. 14 (e)) similar to those of the training set, ensuring a consistent yet diverse evaluation protocol. For the validation set, human verification was conducted through track-level screening rather than exhaustive frame-by-frame correction. Tracks exhibiting identity switches, severe drift, or target loss were regenerated, and 10% of frames from accepted tracks were additionally sampled for manual inspection to iteratively refine the annotation pipeline. Overall, the resulting dataset is both large-scale and structurally complex, making it well-suited for evaluating robust ego-exo cross-view video understanding. Fig. 15 provides the examples from the final curated dataset, and Fig. 16 provides qualitative results of dataset curation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 应用拟议的伪标签校准管道,形成一个大型伪密集数据集,包含708个培训视频和191个验证视频,总共分别为14M和172K个注解帧. 在这里,一个视频对应一个独特的收录,每个音轨被定义为一个独特的(收录,对象)对. 因此,当对多个对象进行注释时,单个视频可能包含多个音轨. 音轨总数在训练集中为3K,在验证集中为300,帧计数是通过将所有帧汇总到不同音轨来计算. 与最初的零星说明相比,我们的管道大大增加了时间覆盖面,使框架层面能够对各种情况进行监督。 如图14所示,数据集涵盖广泛的活动,包括烹饪,体育,以及日常行为. 对象一般占据着框的一小部分,使得在大视线变化和封存下分割和交叉视图的通信更具挑战性. 在构建验证拆分时,我们仔细抽取视频,以保存任务类别(图14(c))和对象尺度(图14(e))的分布,与训练集类似,确保评价协议一致而多样. 对于鉴定组,人力核查是通过轨迹一级的筛选进行的,而不是通过逐帧的彻底修正进行的。 重新生成了显示身份开关、严重漂移或目标丢失的轨迹,还从接受轨迹中抽取了10%的帧供人工检查,以反复改进注释管道。 总体来说,由此产生的数据集既规模大,结构复杂,因此非常适合评价强健的自我-exo跨视视频理解. 图15提供了最终整理数据集的实例,图16提供了数据集整理流程的质量结果。

blocks.en: Appendix D Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录D 评价

blocks.en: D.1 Evaluation Dataset
blocks.zh: D.1 评价数据集

blocks.en:
Our validation set consists of 191 takes and 300 tracks, yielding 172K densely annotated frames per direction, 344K in total across Ego2Exo and Exo2Ego. All validation tracks underwent track-level human screening rather than exhaustive frame-by-frame correction, as detailed in Appendix C.5 . The official Ego-Exo4D Grauman et al. (2024) Correspondence benchmark provides 1 FPS annotations over 202 validation takes and 291 test takes, containing approximately 290K and 420K masks across both views, respectively. Recent methods construct their evaluation pools from these splits. For instance, V 2 -SAM Pan et al. (2025) evaluates on the test split with approximately 200K (Ego2Exo) and 219K (Exo2Ego) masks, while O-MaMa Mur-Labadia et al. (2025) adopts the same official benchmark protocol as V 2 -SAM on the test v2 split. ObjectRelator Fu et al. (2025) evaluates on the validation split, using 31K (Ego2Exo) and 36K (Exo2Ego) annotated frames. In terms of scale, our 344K masks are comparable in scale to prior evaluation setups.
Moreover, we preserve the underlying data distribution through sampling strategies that maintain task category proportions (Fig. 14 (c)) and object scale distributions (Fig. 14 (e)), ensuring consistency with existing benchmarks.
Furthermore, Ego-Exo4D takes are on average approximately three minutes long and often contain repetitive segments. Evaluating every frame would therefore over-represent duplicate states without improving diversity, while also incurring unnecessary computational cost. To address this, we construct each validation track with up to 600 frames: shorter tracks are kept in full, while longer tracks are uniformly subsampled.
blocks.zh:
我们的验证组由191个采样和300个轨迹组成,每个方向产生172K个密集的注解框,整个Ego2Exo和Exo2Ego共计344K个. 如附录C.5所详述,所有验证轨迹都经过了轨迹一级的人文筛选,而不是逐帧的详尽校正。 Ego-Exo4D Grauman et al. (2024) 函授基准提供了1个FPS说明,超过202个验证度和291个测试度,分别包含约290K和420K两个视角的口罩. 最近的方法构建了从这些划分中得出的评价集合。 例如,V2-SAM Pan等人(2025年)在测试中用约200K(Ego2Exo)和219K(Exo2Ego)口罩进行分解评价,而O-MaMa Mur-Labadia等人(2025年)在测试v2分解上采用与V2-SAM相同的官方基准协议. ObjectRelator Fu et al. (2025) 使用31K(Ego2Exo)和36K(Exo2Ego)附加说明的框架对验证拆分进行评价. 就规模而言,我们的344K口罩在规模上与以前的评价设置相当。
此外,我们通过保持任务类别比例(图14(c))和对象规模分布(图14(e))的取样战略,保持基本数据分布,确保与现有基准保持一致。
此外,Ego-Exo4D平均需要约3分钟的时间,而且往往含有重复的片段。 因此,对每个框架进行评价都会在不改进多样性的情况下重复出现各种情况,同时也会造成不必要的计算费用。 为了解决这个问题,我们用最多600帧构建每个验证轨道:短轨保存完整,而长轨则统一进行分样.

blocks.en: D.2 Evaluation Metric
blocks.zh: D.2 评价计量

blocks.en: Our task requires both accurate mask prediction and stable identity preservation across views and time. Therefore, as we mentioned in Sec. 6.1 of the main paper, we evaluate performance in terms of per-frame segmentation quality and temporal consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们的任务既需要准确的面具预测,也需要在各种观点和时间中稳定地保存身份。 因此,正如我们在主要文件第6.1节中提到的那样,我们从每个框架的分割质量和时间一致性的角度评价业绩。

blocks.en: Per-frame Segmentation Quality. For per-frame segmentation quality, we use region similarity 𝒥 \mathcal{J} , contour accuracy ℱ \mathcal{F} and their average 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J\&F} . 𝒥 \mathcal{J} measures region overlap between the predicted mask and ground-truth mask. This evaluates whether the model segments the correct object region. ℱ \mathcal{F} measures boundary alignment between predicted and ground-truth contours, which captures whether the mask shape is accurate. We report 𝒥 & ℱ = 1 2 ​ ( 𝒥 + ℱ ) \mathcal{J\&F}=\frac{1}{2}(\mathcal{J}+\mathcal{F}) as a balanced score for region and boundary quality.

blocks.en: Fig. 8 illustrates the conceptual difference between the two formulations. In noise-to-mask (Fig. 8 (b)), the model must implicitly reconstruct the RGB scene structure from the conditioning signal before it can perform mask prediction. This intermediate step introduces an implicit noise-to-RGB transport within the trajectory, which is not directly supervised and can produce noisy intermediate representations.
blocks.zh: 图8说明了两种提法在概念上的差异。 在噪声对掩体(图8(b))中,模型必须从调节信号中隐含地重建RGB场景结构,才能进行遮罩预测. 这一中间步骤引入了轨迹内隐含的噪声到RGB运输,这种运输不直接监督,可以产生吵闹的中间表示.

blocks.en: To analyze this behavior, we visualize the per-layer, per-timestep PCA features of the intermediate latent states for both formulations. Specifically, Fig. 9 (d) visualizes the RGB latent trajectory V l V_{l} from the RGB-to-mask design in Fig. 8 (a), while Fig. 9 (e) visualizes the noise latent trajectory X l X_{l} from the noise-to-mask design in Fig. 8 (b). As shown in Fig. 9 (d), the RGB-to-mask trajectory shows significantly cleaner and more structured intermediate representations from the earliest timesteps. Crucially, semantic object regions are captured more precisely in the early layers and timesteps, indicating that grounding in the RGB latent allows the model to focus on cross-view object correspondence from the outset rather than recovering scene structure implicitly. In contrast, the Noise-to-mask trajectory (Fig. 9 (e)) exhibits an implicit transition through RGB-like representations in the early timesteps before converging toward mask prediction. This suggests that the model first spends capacity reconstructing scene content from noise before attending to the target object.
blocks.zh: 为了分析这一行为,我们可视化两种制剂的中间潜态的每层,每步PCA特征. 具体来说,图9(d)从图8(a)的RGB对面具设计中可视化RGB潜伏轨迹Vl V_{l}而图9(e)从图8(b)的噪声对面具设计中可视化噪声潜伏轨迹XlX_{l}. 如图9(d)所示,RGB到面具的轨迹显示,从最早的时间步算起,中间代表明显较清洁,结构更为合理。 关键是,语义物体区域在早期的地层和时序中被更精确地捕捉,表明在RGB潜伏中搁浅使得模型从一开始就能够专注于交叉视图物体的对应,而不是隐含地恢复场景结构. 与此相反,噪声对掩体的轨迹(图9(e))表明,在朝向遮罩预测方向汇合之前,早期通过类似RGB的表示方式,出现了一种隐含的转变。 这表明该模型首先花费能力从噪音中重建场景内容,然后才关注目标对象.

blocks.en: This difference in intermediate representations is also reflected in the final predictions. As shown in Fig. 9 (b), the RGB-to-mask formulation produces masks that better preserve fine object details and boundaries, closely aligning with the input RGB observation in Fig. 9 (a). In contrast, the Noise-to-mask prediction in Fig. 9 (c) tends to be less precise and exhibit degraded structure, indicating weaker semantic grounding. These results confirm that the RGB-to-mask formulation provides a more effective initialization for cross-view temporal mask prediction. By starting from a source state that already encodes scene layout and object appearance, the transport field is entirely devoted to converting visual evidence into query-conditioned masks, leading to more reliable and semantically grounded predictions.
blocks.zh: 中间表述的这种差异也反映在最终预测中. 如图9(b)所示,RGB对面具配方产生的口罩能够更好地保存精细的物体细节和边界,与图9(a)中的输入RGB观察紧密一致. 与此相对照,图9(c)中的噪声对掩体预测往往不太精确,并显示出退化的结构,表明语义定位较弱。 这些结果证实RGB-to-mask配方为跨视时间罩预测提供了更有效的初始化. 通过从一个已经编码场景布局和物体外观的源态开始,运输领域完全致力于将视觉证据转换成有查询条件的口罩,从而导致更加可靠和有聚合基础的预测.

blocks.en:
Beyond representational quality, the two formulations also differ substantially in computational cost. In the Noise-to-mask formulation, the model requires both the noise latent and the RGB latent as separate inputs, as the noise latent serves as the initial state of the flow, while the RGB observation must be provided as an additional conditioning signal.
In the diptych setting with paired ego-exo videos, the Noise-to-mask formulation processes both noise and RGB tokens from the two views, along with mask-conditioning tokens.
Let N N denote the total number of RGB tokens across both views, and N cond N_{\mathrm{cond}} denote the number of mask-conditioning tokens, including the query-side mask and target-side zero-mask regions.
Excluding optional local-crop tokens, the Noise-to-mask formulation requires approximately 2 ​ N + N cond 2N+N_{\mathrm{cond}} tokens.
In contrast, the RGB-to-mask formulation directly sets the RGB latent as the source state, eliminating the need for separate noise tokens and reducing the sequence length to approximately N + N cond N+N_{\mathrm{cond}} .
Since self-attention cost scales quadratically with sequence length, the relative attention cost is proportional to ( 2 ​ N + N cond N + N cond ) 2 \left(\frac{2N+N_{\mathrm{cond}}}{N+N_{\mathrm{cond}}}\right)^{2} .
Thus, the Noise-to-mask formulation incurs higher attention cost, approaching four times that of RGB-to-mask when N N dominates N cond N_{\mathrm{cond}} .
blocks.zh:
除了代表质量之外,这两种表述在计算成本方面也有很大不同。 在噪声对任务配制中,该模型要求噪声潜伏和RGB潜伏作为单独的输入,因为噪声潜伏是流的初始状态,而RGB观测必须作为附加的调制信号提供.
在配对自负-Exo视频的diptych设定中,噪声对面具的配制同时处理来自两种观点的噪声和RGB符号,以及口罩空调符号.
让 N 表示两个视图的 RGB 符号的总数,而 N cond N_{\ mathrm{cond}} 表示口罩空调符号的数量,包括查询面罩和靶面零掩码区域.
除可选的当地作物标志外,噪声对任务配制需要大约 2 N + N 康德 2N + N_{\ mathrm{康德}} 令牌.
与此相对照,RGB-to-mask配方将RGB的潜伏物直接设定为源态,从而不再需要单独的噪声符号,并将序列长度缩短到约N + N cond N + N_{\ mathrm{cond}}}.
由于自留心成本与序列长度的四倍比分,相对关注成本与(2 N + N cond N + N cond N + N cond ) 2\左(\frac{2 N + N_{\mathrm{cond}}}{N+ N_{\mathrm{cond}}}\right)===2}成正比.
因此,噪声对任务配方的注意成本较高,在N主导N cond N_{\mathrm{cond}}}时接近RGB对任务的四倍。

blocks.en:
As a result, the RGB-to-mask formulation offers advantages in both representation quality and computational efficiency in our setting.
It provides a more semantically grounded and structured initialization that enables effective cross-view object correspondence from the earliest timesteps, while reducing the token sequence length and substantially lowering attention cost.
blocks.zh:
因此,在我们的环境下,RGB到任务配方在代表性质量和计算效率方面都提供了优势。
它提供了一种更精密的基于和结构化的初始化,能够从最早的时间步起有效的交叉视图对象对应,同时缩短符号序列长度,并大幅降低关注成本.

blocks.en: E.2.1 Unified Token Space and the Implicit Matching Problem
blocks.zh: E.2.1 统一托肯空间与隐性匹配问题

blocks.en: In our framework, query and target tokens are jointly encoded as z rgb z_{\text{rgb}} in a unified token space via diptych, where all tokens are processed within a single shared representation, regardless of their view or temporal signal. The 3D full attention mechanism enables unrestricted interaction across views and timesteps, allowing each token to attend to any other token in the sequence, as illustrated in Fig. 7 . This architectural choice is precisely what enables cross-view and cross-temporal reasoning, as discussed in the main paper. However, while the model is given the capacity to establish correspondences across views and time, the architecture itself imposes no explicit constraint that target object tokens must attend to the semantically correct query object tokens. In other words, correspondence is left entirely to implicit matching via self-attention which globally operates on the entire sequence, and there is no supervisory signal that directly encourages the model to focus on the correct object region during the attention computation.
blocks.zh: 在我们的框架中,查询和目标符号通过diptych在一个统一的符号空间中被联合编码为z rgb z_{\text{rgb}}],所有符号都在一个共享的表示中处理,而不论其观点或时间信号如何. 3D全注意力机制可以不受限制地在各种观点和时间步间进行互动,使每个令牌能够关注序列中的任何其他令牌,如图所示. 7 (英语). 正如主要论文所讨论的那样,这种建筑选择正是使交叉视图和跨时空推理成为可能。 然而,虽然该模型被赋予了建立跨视图和跨时间的对应关系的能力,但架构本身并没有施加任何明确的制约,目标对象符号必须关注精准正确的查询对象符号. 换句话说,通信完全由通过自意进行隐含的匹配来决定,而自意在全球运行于整个序列上,没有监督信号直接鼓励模型在注意力计算时关注正确的对象区域.

blocks.en: E.2.2 Attention Dispersion as a Root Cause of Failure
blocks.zh: E.2.2 注意力分散作为失败的根源

blocks.en: We hypothesize that this reliance on purely implicit matching becomes a critical bottleneck, especially in complex scenes. When multiple objects are present, or when the target scene contains distractors that share visual similarity or semantic similarity with the query object, attention tends to disperse broadly across semantically irrelevant regions rather than concentrating on the correct correspondence. This dispersion prevents the model from extracting a sufficiently discriminative cross-view representation, resulting in incorrect or incomplete mask predictions. Critically, this failure mode is not resolved by simply scaling model capacity or training data, since without an explicit grounding signal, the model has no way to resolve ambiguous attention patterns.
blocks.zh: 我们假设这种对纯粹隐含匹配的依赖会成为一个关键的瓶颈,特别是在复杂的场景中. 当存在多个对象时,或者当目标场景中含有与查询对象具有视觉相似性或语义相似性的分光器时,注意力往往在与星系无关的区域之间广泛分散,而不是集中在正确的对应上. 这种散射使得模型无法提取出足够具有歧视性的交叉视图表示,导致面具预测不正确或不完整. 关键的是,这种故障模式不能简单地通过缩放模型能力或培训数据来解决,因为没有明确的地面信号,模型无法解决模糊的注意模式.

blocks.en: E.2.3 Why Focal Attention Alignment Works
blocks.zh: 经济及社会理事会 焦点协调工作为何

blocks.en: These observations motivate the design of focal attention alignment as an explicit supervision signal that encourages cross-view attention A ego → exo A^{\text{ego}\rightarrow\text{exo}} and A exo → ego A^{\text{exo}\rightarrow\text{ego}} to concentrate on the correct object region during training. Rather than relying solely on the downstream mask prediction loss to implicitly shape attention, focal attention alignment directly regularizes the attention distribution toward the ground-truth object region, providing a more direct and localized training signal. This not only improves attention localization but also yields more discriminative cross-view representations, as the model is guided to extract object-centric features rather than scene-level statistics. The result is a measurable improvement in correspondence accuracy, especially in complex scenes, where implicit matching is most prone to failure, as reflected in the quantitative results in the main paper.

Although V 2 -SAM achieves strong scores on mask quality related metrics such as 𝒥 \mathcal{J} , ℱ \mathcal{F} , and 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} , its match-then-track pipeline is highly dependent on the quality of the initial cross-view match. In contrast, our method directly reasons over cross-view temporal correspondence and more reliably localizes the target object’s presence across frames. blocks.en: The performance gap is particularly pronounced in the Ego2Exo direction, which we attribute to the inherently higher ambiguity of egocentric query frames. Egocentric views are characterized by frequent object truncation, rapid camera motion, and heavily occluded or partially visible objects, making it substantially harder to extract reliable query representations on a per-frame basis. This stands in contrast to the Exo2Ego direction, where exocentric query frames tend to provide more stable and complete object observations, partially mitigating the limitations of frame-level inference.
blocks.zh: 性能差距在Ego2Exo方向上尤其明显,我们将此归因于自我中心查询框架固有的更高模糊性. 偏心视图的特点是频繁的物体截断,快速的相机运动,以及大量被占用或部分可见的物体,使得在每帧基础上提取可靠的查询表示物变得非常困难. 这与Exo2Ego方向形成对比,exocentral查询帧倾向于提供更稳定和完整的对象观测,部分减轻了帧层推论的局限性.

blocks.en: These characteristics directly manifest in the failure modes of both existing paradigms, track-then-match and match-then-track pipelines. In the T → M \text{T}\rightarrow\text{M} paradigm, although tracking yields temporally consistent query object tracks, the per-frame matching to the target view is performed independently at each timestep with no mechanism to enforce temporal coherence on the target side. The degraded query signal in egocentric query frames thus directly corrupts each frame-level match, and the absence of any cross-frame aggregation, that is temporal context aggregation, leaves these errors unrecoverable. In the M → T \text{M}\rightarrow\text{T} paradigm, the initial match quality is entirely contingent on the frame-level query signal, and the subsequent tracker Ravi et al. (2024) inevitably propagates any erroneous initialization throughout the sequence.
blocks.zh: 这些特征直接表现在既有范式的故障模式,赛道当时的赛道和赛道时的赛道管道上. 在 T → M\ text{ T}\rightarrow\text{ M} 范式中,虽然跟踪产生时间上一致的查询对象轨迹,但每个时段都独立执行与目标视图的每帧匹配,没有机制强制目标一侧的时间一致性. 以自我为中心的查询框中退化的查询信号直接腐蚀了每个帧级的匹配,而没有任何跨帧聚合,即时间上下文聚合,使得这些错误无法恢复. 在M → T\text{M}\rightarrow\text{T}范式中,初始匹配质量完全取决于帧级查询信号,以及后续的跟踪器Ravi等人. (2024)不可避免地在整个序列中传播任何错误的初始化.

blocks.en: In contrast, our unified framework addresses these limitations by reasoning over the full temporal extent of the query sequence rather than individual frames. By aggregating complementary object observations across time, our method is able to compensate for frames in which the query object is absent or ambiguous, constructing a richer and more discriminative query representation that remains robust even under the challenging viewpoint conditions of egocentric capture. Overall, XTrack achieves strong temporal retention across both directions, with particularly competitive performance under challenging egocentric query conditions.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,我们的统一框架通过对查询序列的全部时间范围进行推理而不是个别框架来解决这些局限性。 通过将互补对象观察汇总到不同时间,我们的方法能够补偿查询对象缺失或模糊不清的帧,构建一个更丰富和更具歧视性的查询代表,即使在以自我为中心的捕捉这种挑战性条件下,这种表达仍然有力。 总体而言,XTrack在两个方向上都实现了强劲的时间保留,在充满挑战的自我中心查询条件下表现特别有竞争力.

blocks.en: Appendix G Limitations and Discussion
blocks.zh: 附录G 限制和讨论

blocks.en: G.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: G.1 限制

blocks.en: Extremely small objects. XTrack can struggle when the queried object is extremely small. Local context crops alleviate this issue by providing relatively higher-resolution local object evidence, but the final prediction is still produced in the compressed latent space of the video DiT. Therefore, if the object occupies only a few latent tokens, fine-grained boundaries or small appearance cues can still be lost. This mainly affects very small or heavily compressed objects, while the local context branch improves robustness in most small-object cases.
blocks.zh: 极小的物体。 当被询问对象极小时, XTrack 可以挣扎 。 局部背景作物通过提供相对较高的分辨率局部物体证据来缓解这个问题,但最终预测仍然在视频DiT的压缩潜伏空间中产生. 因此,如果物体只占据了几个潜在的标志,细微的界限或小的外观提示仍然可能丢失. 这主要影响非常小或高度压缩的物体,而局部上下文分支在大多数小对象案件中提高强性.

blocks.en: Limited context length. XTrack inherits the finite context length of the pretrained video DiT. For long videos, we process sequences in chunks and merge the predictions afterward. This enables long-sequence inference in practice, but the model cannot attend to arbitrarily distant frames within a single forward pass. Extending the temporal context or adding memory mechanisms would further improve long-range consistency.
blocks.zh: 上下文长度有限。 XTrack继承了预训视频DiT的有限上下文长度. 对于长视频,我们按块处理序列,然后合并预测。 这使得在实践中可以进行长序推论,但模型不能在单个前行通道内任意处理遥远的帧. 延长时间背景或增加记忆机制将进一步提高长期一致性。

blocks.en: Inference cost. As a diffusion-based model, XTrack requires iterative denoising at inference. This makes inference slower than feed-forward segmentation or tracking models. However, this cost comes from repurposing a generative video backbone for joint cross-view temporal prediction, and can likely be reduced with faster samplers Lu et al. (2025) , distillation Yin et al. (2024) ; Zhu et al. (2024) ; Frans et al. (2025) , or fewer denoising steps Luo et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2024) ; Garcia et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 推论成本. 作为一种基于扩散的模型,XTrack需要在推论上进行迭代解析. 这使得推论比向饲料分解或跟踪模型慢. 然而,这一成本来自重新使用基因视频主干线进行联合交叉视时预测,并且可以通过更快的采样器Lu等人(2025年)进行蒸馏而降低成本。 Yin等人(2024年);Zhu等人(2024年);Frans等人(2025年),或更少的去诺化步骤 Luo等人(2023年);Liu等人(2024年);Garcia等人(2025年)。

blocks.en: G.2 Discussion and Future Work
blocks.zh: G.2 讨论和今后的工作

blocks.en: Improving small-object representation. The difficulty with extremely small objects mainly arises from the spatial compression of latent representations. A promising direction is to incorporate multi-scale latent processing Ho et al. (2021) ; Gu et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2025) ; Jin et al. (2025) , where high-resolution tokens are selectively preserved or fused with global tokens. Another approach is to adapt the VAE Chen et al. (2025) ; Kouzelis et al. (2025) to retain more fine-grained spatial details for object-centric regions, or to introduce hierarchical tokenization Razavi et al. (2019) ; Zhou et al. (2025) that allocates more capacity to small objects.
blocks.zh: 改进小对象表述. 极小物体的困难主要来自潜在表示的空间压缩。 一个有希望的方向是纳入多尺度潜在加工Ho等人(2021年);Gu等人(2024年); 张等人(2025年); 龚等人(2025年),其中高分辨率的代币有选择地保存或与全球代币融合. 另一种方法是调整VAE Chen等人(2025年);Kouzelis等人(2025年),为以物体为中心的区域保留更多精细的空间细节,或引入等级标志化的Razavi等人(2019年);周等人(2025年),为小物体分配更多容量.

blocks.en: Extending temporal context. The current chunk-based processing limits the ability to model very long temporal dependencies within a single forward pass. Future work could explore memory-augmented architectures or recurrent token mechanisms that allow information to persist across chunks. Another direction is to integrate retrieval-based or keyframe-based conditioning, enabling the model to access long-range temporal context without increasing computational cost significantly.
blocks.zh: 扩展时间背景. 目前基于块的处理限制了在单一前进通道内模拟非常长的时间依赖的能力。 今后的工作可以探索记忆强化结构或经常性的象征机制,使信息能够持续跨越各个块。 另一个方向是整合基于检索或键框的调制,使模型能够访问长距离时间背景,而不会大大增加计算成本.

blocks.en: Reducing inference cost. The diffusion-based formulation introduces higher computational cost due to iterative denoising. This can be addressed by adopting more efficient sampling strategies, such as fewer-step solvers or distillation into feed-forward models. Additionally, hybrid approaches that combine diffusion for global reasoning with lightweight refinement networks may provide a favorable trade-off between efficiency and performance.
blocks.zh: 减少推论费用。 基于传播的配方由于迭代去诺而引入了更高的计算成本. 可以通过采用更有效的取样战略来解决这一问题,例如减少分步解决器或将蒸馏分解成饲料推进模型。 此外,将全球推理传播与轻量级改进网络相结合的混合办法,可能在效率和业绩之间作出有利的权衡。

(a) Forward-only propagation produces temporally inconsistent results, including missing masks and inaccurate object localization. (b) Backward propagation still exhibits similar failure cases, including incorrect propagations and ambiguous predictions. Dataset Curation Pipeline. Several recent video segmentation datasets follow a similar high-level recipe of sparsely annotating anchor frames and propagating masks to obtain dense supervision, but they differ substantially in how each stage is instantiated.
For initial mask generation, UVO Wang et al. (2021) , VISOR Darkhalil et al. (2022) , and HD-EPIC Perrett et al. (2025) rely on manual annotation of anchor frames. Matrix-11K Jin et al. (2026) replaces manual annotation by automatically selecting an anchor frame using a VLM and generating the initial mask with SAM2. MUVOD Wei et al. (2025) initializes masks on sparsely sampled keyframes using SAM Kirillov et al. (2023) conditioned on manually drawn bounding boxes, followed by manual refinement. In contrast, our pipeline is anchored entirely on the existing Ego-Exo4D annotations and does not introduce any additional manual labeling.
blocks.zh:
数据集Curation管道. 最近的一些视频分解数据集遵循了一种类似的高级配方,即很少注意锚架和传播口罩,以获得密集的监督,但它们在每一阶段如何即时化方面差别很大。
对于最初的面具生成,UVO Wang 等人(2021年),VISOR Darkhalil 等人(2022年),HD-EPIC Perret 等人(2025年)依靠对锚架的人工注释. 矩阵-1K Jin et al. (2026)通过使用VLM自动选择锚框,用SAM2生成初始面罩来代替手动注释. MUVOD Wei 等 (英语). (2025年)使用SAM Kirillov等人(2023年)在鲜有样本的密钥框上初始化口罩,以手动绘制的边框为条件,然后手动改进. 相比之下,我们的管道完全依靠现有的Ego-Exo4D说明,没有引入任何额外的人工标签.

blocks.en: For temporal propagation, UVO and VISOR adopt bidirectional STM Oh et al. (2019) from sparse anchors, with logits weighted by the temporal distance to the nearest annotated frame. HD-EPIC propagates hand masks bidirectionally with SAM2 Ravi et al. (2024) by inserting manually annotated frames into its conditional memory. Matrix-11K propagates SAM2 forward from a single VLM-selected anchor frame. MUVOD employs XMem Cheng and Schwing (2022) for bidirectional temporal propagation from corrected keyframes to recover content occluded in the reference frame. We also perform bidirectional propagation using SAM2.
blocks.zh: 就时间传播而言,UVO和VISOR采用双向的STM Oh等人(2019年)从零星锚地,以时间距离加权到最近附加说明的框架。 HD-EPIC与SAM2 Ravi等人(2024年)双向传播手罩,在其有条件的内存中插入手动附加说明的帧. Matrix-11K从一个单一的VLM选择的锚框向前传播SAM2. MUVOD使用XMem Cheng和Schwing(2022)从校正键框进行双向时间传播,以回收参考框中隐含的内容。 我们还使用SAM2进行双向传播。

blocks.en:
A key distinction lies in how propagation failures are handled. UVO and MUVOD do not define a per-frame automatic failure criterion and instead rely on human intervention. HD-EPIC adopts a heuristic based on abrupt changes in mask area between consecutive frames to identify noisy predictions, followed by local correction and re-propagation. Matrix-11K filters at the video level via VLM verification rather than at the frame or mask level, providing no signal about the reliability of individual propagated frames. VISOR is the only prior work that introduces an explicit quantitative criterion: each interpolated mask is validated by propagating it back to both annotated endpoints and computing the average 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} , after which masks below a threshold are discarded. While effective, however, as discussed in Sec. C , this method does not directly assess the reliability of intermediate frames.
In contrast, our approach defines failure at the chunk level by measuring the disagreement between forward and backward SAM2 predictions, yielding a per-frame reliability signal without requiring additional manual annotations. This enables fully automatic large-scale curation while remaining applicable beyond Ego-Exo4D.
blocks.zh:
一个关键的区别在于如何处理传播失败。 UVO和MUVOD没有定义一个每帧自动故障标准,而是依赖于人类干预. HD-EPIC采用基于连续帧间遮罩区域突变的heuristic,以识别噪音预测,然后是局部校正和再传播. 矩阵-11K滤波器通过VLM校验,而不是帧或遮罩级,不提供单个传播帧可靠性的信号. VISOR是之前唯一引入明确定量标准的作品:每个插口罩通过将它传播回附加说明的端点和计算平均J&F\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}来验证,然后丢弃一个阈值以下的口罩. 然而,如Sec.C所述,这种方法虽然有效,但并不直接评估中间帧的可靠性。
与此相反,我们的方法通过测量前向和后向的SAM2预测之间的分歧来定义在块级的失败,产生每帧可靠性信号而不需要额外的人工说明. 这使得完全自动的大规模管理成为可能,同时在Ego-Exo4D之外仍然适用。

blocks.en: Video Diffusion Model. Video diffusion models have evolved from U-Net backbones inflated from image diffusion Blattmann et al. (2023a) ; Blattmann et al. (2023b) ; Ho et al. (2022) , which effectively capture local motion but struggle to scale to long-range dependencies, to Diffusion Transformers (DiT) Peebles and Xie (2023) that model global spatiotemporal interactions through full attention Brooks et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2024b) ; Li et al. (2024) ; Polyak et al. (2025) . Building on this architectural shift, recent advances have further redefined the generative paradigm through Flow Matching Lipman et al. (2022) ; Liu et al. (2022) , which generalizes diffusion by learning a continuous velocity field along a deterministic ODE trajectory between arbitrary distributions. This formulation has been adopted by state-of-the-art video DiTs such as Wan Wan et al. (2025) , enabling more flexible and efficient modeling of complex video dynamics.
blocks.zh: 视频传播模式. 视频传播模型是从图像传播Blattmann等人(2023a)的U-Net骨干中膨胀出来的;Blattmann等人(2023b); Ho等人(2022年),通过充分关注Brooks等人(2024年);Yang等人(2024年b月);Li等人(2024年);Polyak等人(2025年)。 在这种建筑转变的基础上,最近的进展通过Flow Matching Lipman等人(2022年);Liu等人(2022年)进一步重新定义了基因范式,通过在任意分布之间的确定性ODE轨迹上学习持续速度场来概括传播. 这一提法已被Wan Wan等人(2025年)等最先进的视频DiT所采用,使得复杂的视频动态能够更加灵活高效地建模.

blocks.en: Rather than using these models purely for synthesis, we repurpose their role through the lens of perception. Specifically, we build on Wan as our backbone, leveraging its pretrained spatiotemporal priors and repurposing them for cross-view reasoning. By doing so, we redirect the model’s generative capacity toward predicting object masks jointly across views and over time, enabling consistent object correspondence in a unified spatiotemporal framework.
blocks.zh: 与其纯粹地使用这些模型进行合成,不如通过感知的透镜重新发挥它们的作用. 具体地说,我们以万为骨干,利用它预先训练的spatiental experiments,并将其重新用于交叉视角推理. 通过这样做,我们把模型的基因能力转向跨视界和跨时段共同预测物体遮罩,从而能够在统一的瞬间框架内进行一致的物体对应。
